## Activity

During March 2025, the clinic team at River Outreach completed 64 captures. This activity provides the month’s operational baseline and supports review of image quality and grading outcomes. The reported activity covers the captures completed through the site’s outreach service during the month.

## Image quality

Of the 64 captures, 2 were recorded as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.1 per cent. This result indicates that most captures were available for grading, while the ungradable cases should continue to be monitored through routine site review. No new equipment faults were raised by staff this month.

## Grading

A total of 5 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 1 days. These figures should be considered together with the image-quality results when reviewing the site’s monthly performance. The activity, image-quality, and grading measures provide a concise record of operations at River Outreach for March 2025.
